items: 【Stand Out Among The Dazzling Array Of Pregnancy Gifts Basket! 】A bear theme makes this gift extra cute! It includes the baby's necessities - beanie hat, onesie, bibs, baby mittens, funny socks; as well as exclusive insulation tumbler and a decision coin for mom and dad. Still thinking which one to buy as a baby shower gifts? Don't hesitate, this will be the perfect new mom gifts for women that you can express your blessings.

【Cotton Baby Essentials】Be prepared with the new baby announcement - onesies, socks, bibs with fun quotes are custom made for pregnancy announcements to announce that the adventure has begun! Baby mittens prevent baby from scratching himself; the beanie hat keeps the baby warm, and with a bear pattern, creating a cute atmosphere. The complete baby gift sets comes in a neutral white color for a baby boy or girl, it's even easier as a gender reveal gifts!

【New Mom And Dad Tumbler】The new parent couple tumbler that never goes out of style! We deliberately removed the printing of the words "Est 2023/2024",so that mom and dad can use it for a long time! Made of 18/8 food grade stainless steel, it won't transfer flavors and is unbreakable! BPA free; comes with a clear push-on lid that keeps warm for hours(Hot:3h & Cold:9h), perfect for home or travel.

【Fun Decision Coins】Make fun decision coins for new parents about to embark on a new journey. Double-sided lettering, one side is dad and the other is mom, which can help new parents relieve the dreaded parenting pressure, who will do the work of changing diapers in the middle of the night? Let this coin decide! Comes with a blank greeting card to write your love and wishes.

【Perfect Gift Idea For Expecting Parents】Whether it's a baby shower, gender reveal, pregnancy announcement or mother's day, father's day, Christmas, anniversaries, this women gift basket (baby gift sets) is the perfect choice for first time new moms and dads! We want the recipients of our gifts to absolutely love them. This baby gift can be used as baby boy gifts or baby girl gifts!
